name: dependabot-safe-merge
description: Safely refresh, review, and merge eligible Dependabot pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Safely refresh and merge Dependabot PRs
interface.longDescription: Refresh Dependabot pull requests to a verified release at least 24 hours old, review breaking changes, and enable auto-merge only after every repository gate passes.
defaultPrompt: Use $dependabot-safe-merge to review and safely merge this Dependabot pull request.
